title: Replay real KRN failures cut before the wrong decision and measure repeats per harness revision
body:
Operator-pasted note 2026-11-17 (unverified; source: GPT-6.2 system card, "AgentReplay"): OpenAI replays a real Codex session whose error an independent grader confirmed, truncated just before the wrong decision, and measures how often a model repeats it. KRN has such sessions: ship/merge-state misreads, lanes writing in the wrong worktree (2026-11-17 isolation conflict), Stop loops.
Files: evals/replay/agent-replay.ts, evals/replay/fixtures/agent-replay/
Outcome: a command takes a recorded Claude Code transcript plus the turn index before a confirmed wrong decision, resumes a fresh session from that prefix under the current harness, and grades whether the wrong decision repeats; a suite of at least 5 real KRN failures prints the repeat rate per harness revision.
Proof: node evals/replay/agent-replay.ts --suite --dry-run lists the 5 cases with their cut points, exit 0; a live run prints repeat rate before and after one harness fix.
